name: multi-dashboard-saas-kit
description: Premium multi-tenant SaaS dashboard starter kit with React, Tailwind, Express, and PostgreSQL.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace @saas-kit/backend && npm run build --workspace @saas-kit/backend && npm run build --workspace @saas-kit/frontend
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @saas-kit/frontend -- --mode pages-demo --base /multi-dashboard-saas-kit/
